basic_info.description:
New Construction!  This wonderful townhome style condominium has everything you could ever want, all on only 2 levels!  All 3  bedrooms are generously sized.   The elegant primary suite has a walk-in closet, as well as an upper-level deck which overlooks the quiet neighborhood along Cambridge Street.  There is also an attached 1- bay garage!  So, you will have 2 decks, one on each level, plus the community gathering area with a basketball hoop and doggie station!
Additionally, there are a variety of shopping and dining options close by, as well as easy access to Bart at either Balboa Park or Glen Park Stations.  You can have it all:  your home sanctuary with convenience and excitement.
